notes.title: New game - Marisa's weird little monster hunt is announced!
notes.content:
After years of development, including works with many triple A companies, I would like to proudly announce that the new game: "[b]Marisa's Weird Little Adventure[/b]" Will be Released soon!

This wonderful game is created with non other than [b]The source engine!!![/b] Featuring 800 hours of gameplay, details we missed intentionally, sidequests that no one cares about and an exciting boss battle with a boss that have 8000k health and the ability to regenerate! this will surely be one of the most amazing gaming experience anyone would ever have

Pre-Order now!
